svg.title: The Russian Campaign, Deluxe Fifth Edition

g.text: Designer Signature Edition -- John Edwards, Todd Davis
Baltic Sea - Gulf of Finland Movement
Successful on die roll of 2 or less.
-1 for each of Helsinki, Leningrad, Riga, Tallinn controlled
+1 evacuation; +2 Russian, if Germans control Leningrad
Black Sea - Sea of Azov Movement
1 unit per side per turn. Successful on die roll of 3 or less.
-1 for each of Odessa, Sevastopol, Rostov controlled
Swamp: 1 MP, stop; clear in Snow
River: defender x2 if all attackers on river hexes
Blocked hexside: no movement, no ZOC
